abilitygroupinfo.slug: Though this be madness, yet there is method in't.

abilitydescription.p: Spiritual Torment occurs when the character is haunted or possessed by one or more demons or evil spirits. If a character is compelled by spritual torment they must choose either to suffer the mental torment from defying the will of the spirits; including flashbacks, nightmares, and severe anxiety; or they can obey those evil influences.
Aspect saves may be triggered during the following times:

descriptions.description: as the fiends that possess the character try desperately to stop them from achieving some good dead.
descriptions.term: Character has opened the Doors of Sin,
descriptions.description: when the character has transgressed or performed some wrongdoing. At these times their resistance to wicked influences is reduced.
descriptions.term: During the Vulnerability of the Night
descriptions.description: When the character may be beset by nightmares and wake in a screaming fit.

abilitydescription.p:
FIXME
Psychological suffering was sometimes seen as a test of faith, a penance, or a punishment from God.

FIXME
Killing in battle—even in a righteous or holy war—was believed to stain the soul, requiring formal penances, cleansing rituals, or prayers mandated by the Church. The victory of compassion.

FIXME
Chronic distress, extreme fear, or combat fatigue were generally described loosely as a form of "madness," melancholy, or deep spiritual despair (accidie).
